title: Quantization profile support and accuracy-validation pipeline for FP8/INT8
creator: Asha Menon
description: Build a repeatable pipeline that (1) registers and validates FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles, (2) runs calibration workflows over curated datasets, and (3) emits model quality metrics (perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy, Rouge/BLEU, task-specific scorers) against baselines. Deliverables: an evaluation harness service, CI gating checks for quantized model rollouts, artifacts storage for calibration maps/scales, and a Console dashboard page that surfaces per-model quantization reports and regression alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Support for at least two quantization profiles per model: FP8 and INT8 (static and dynamic where applicable)
Calibration job produces and stores a calibration artifact (per-layer scale tables / histogram stats) linked to model version

Evaluation harness computes and records: perplexity (language modeling), MMLU-style aggregated accuracy and per-subject breakdowns, Rouge-1/2/L and BLEU for summarization/translation workloads, and task-specific metrics (F1/EM for QA, accuracy for classification, latency and token-cost overhead)
Automated regression checks: fail CI if any quantized variant degrades primary metric beyond configured threshold (default: 1.5% relative drop for P0 models) unless approved via exception
Console: new 'Quantization QA' tab showing trend charts for each metric, calibration artifact links, and rollout readiness badge
design_decisions: Use two kinds of calibration workflows: static (offline histogram+min-max/per-channel scale computation) for INT8, and dynamic (activation-aware / per-token online calibration) for FP8 experiments
Store calibration artifacts as immutable objects in object-store with metadata: model_version, profile_id, dataset_snapshot_hash
Implement quality metrics as separate modular scorers so new tasks can be added without changing core harness
Use the current evaluation runner (evals-service) as the base and extend with quantization-aware runtimes to produce token-level timings and KV-cache probes
implementation_notes: Create new module quantize/runner that accepts: model binary, profile spec (FP8/INT8 + per-layer hints), calibration dataset URI, and target evaluation list
Re-use existing dataset snapshots in s3://redwood-evals/ and add a quant-cal-sets index that tags examples for calibration vs validation
Calibration outputs: JSON table of per-layer scales, optional bias-correction params, and histogram dumps for offline debugging
Validation outputs: CSV/JSON report with metric name, value, baseline_value, relative_delta, sample_count, and seed
Expose an API endpoint /v1/quant-eval that triggers jobs and returns a job id for status polling
CI gating: add a github action that triggers quant-eval for PRs that modify runtime or quantization mapping logic; action fails on hard threshold breaches
Rollout strategy: deploy quantized model variants behind rollout flags; initially run in canary mode with 5% traffic and shadow evaluation for 24h
test_plan: Unit tests for quantize/runner: profile parsing, artifact serialization, error paths
Synthetic calibration smoke tests on small models to validate pipeline end-to-end in <15m
Regression suite: run MMLU-lite (subset of 57 subjects), Wikitext perplexity on 5k tokens, SQuAD v2 F1/EM, XSum Rouge/BLEU on 200 examples
Performance tests to capture latency and throughput changes induced by quantization kernel selection
A/B experiment: compare FP16 baseline vs INT8/FP8 variant on production traffic (shadow) and collect metric deltas
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: calibration datasets may not capture distribution shift. Mitigation: require dataset_snapshot_hash and add sampling heuristics to include tail tokens and contextual lengths
Risk: some models produce brittle metrics (noise in Rouge/BLEU). Mitigation: aggregate with bootstrap confidence intervals and show per-slice breakdowns
Risk: FP8 dynamic calibration could increase latency. Mitigation: measure per-request CPU/GPU overhead and provide a toggle to only use FP8 in dedicated pools
Risk: false positives in CI regressions due to nondeterminism. Mitigation: re-run on fixed seeds and compare with stored baseline artifact; only then block PR
